note: Generic reconstruction-plate profiles grouped by size class. This is NOT a
manufacturer catalogue and contains no vendor part numbers. Every dimension
here is a starting default that you must check against the specification
sheet of the system you are actually holding, then edit this file to match.
bend_warning_deg and min_bend_radius_mm are working limits you set for
yourself; they are not manufacturer ratings.

systems.name: 2.4 mm reconstruction bar, straight
systems.notes: Load-bearing bar for a segmental defect. Bicortical screws.

systems.name: 2.7 mm reconstruction bar, straight
systems.notes: Stiffer bar for long defects; harder to contour by hand.

systems.name: 2.0 mm reconstruction plate, straight
systems.notes: Thinner and easier to contour; less rigid across a long span.

systems.name: 2.4 mm pre-bent angle bar (body to ramus)
systems.notes: Comes with the gonial angle already formed; only the residual bend is yours to make.

systems.name: Patient-specific (custom) plate
systems.notes: Made to the planned path, so no chairside bending. Any path length fits.
